name: project-question
prompt: How does the counter on this page work?

name: small-edit
prompt: Change the heading to Benchmark Counter. Preserve the Increment button, #increment and #count behavior.

name: new-static
prompt: Build a polished static website for Solar Bakery, a synthetic bakery. Include a responsive hero headed Solar Bakery, a menu section id=menu, and a Contact link to #contact with a contact section id=contact. Use static HTML/CSS, no framework, accounts, backend or database. Add a working mobile menu if navigation collapses. It should be ready to preview and publish.

name: new-vite-multi-page
prompt: Build a React/Vite multi-page fitness app for fictional Solar Fitness. Routes /, /classes and /contact; visible navigation links to Classes and Contact. Classes lists Yoga. Contact has labelled fields id=name, id=email, id=message and a Send button id=send; submitting valid values displays Message received in id=contact-status without a backend. Use browser-only state, no accounts or external services. Responsive and ready to preview and publish.

name: new-todo-browser-substitute
prompt: Build a React/Vite Todo app using browser localStorage only, with no login, backend or cloud dependency. This is the browser-storage benchmark substitute until Phase 7. Provide a labelled input id=task-title, button id=add-task, task rows data-task, completion checkboxes and per-task buttons data-delete. Add, complete and delete must persist across page reloads. Show loading/empty/error states and make it responsive and publishable.

name: plan-then-build-this
prompt: Add a Reset button id=reset to the existing counter that resets #count to 0. Preserve increment behavior. Plan the change first.
